purpose: Held-out test of the revised EX1 hypothesis after pure causal prose overgeneralized Runtime reconciliation. The revised treatment keeps causal failure chains but must preserve explicit negative authority laws and classical/domain boundaries.

treatments.repository_first: Three opaque Ordivon owners are defined here. {{HOST}} owns durable semantic Task continuity, exact Task revisions/checkpoints, bounded Context/work requests, consequence-level commitments and participant decisions, verification records, uncertainty, and Task outcomes. {{HARNESS}} owns one bounded Agent Run: selected/model-visible cognition, Provider call state, model-tool interaction, Tool intent/fences, Run budgets, pause/resume/recovery, receipts, and candidate completion proposals. {{RUNTIME}} owns trusted-local physical execution: exact Workspace/Job/Attempt and operation identity, process-tree supervision, bounded Result/Artifact bytes, cancellation, source/executable commitment, and physical reconciliation. Boundaries are strict: a Host checkpoint is not current Runtime/domain truth; a Harness candidate completion is not Task/domain completion; Runtime Execution Result is not an External Effect Receipt and is not Semantic Completion. Arbitrary shell execution remains externally effect-opaque even when its local process evidence is perfect. Provider/domain-specific receipts and semantic judgments stay with CALLER_OR_DOMAIN unless a narrow structured adapter explicitly owns that effect contract. Mature complete mechanics stay with CLASSICAL_SUBSTRATE such as Git, SQLite, operating systems, systemd/cgroups, Provider SDKs, schedulers and external isolation. If no recurring non-bypassable responsibility and real shared-consumer pressure exists, choose NO_SHARED_MECHANISM rather than inventing a service.
treatments.causal_boundary: Start from the concrete failure, then preserve the negative authority laws. {{HOST}} is needed when semantic work itself must outlive replaceable model/Run/process episodes: without one durable Task identity/revision, unresolved purpose, commitments, participant decisions and accepted outcomes disappear or race. {{HARNESS}} is needed when one bounded cognition episode has selected cognition, Provider/tool exchange, budgets, response-loss and pause/resume state that are neither the long-lived Task nor an OS process. {{RUNTIME}} is needed when an admitted action must become identifiable physical local execution whose exact process tree, result bytes, cancellation and reconciliation survive interruption. But the causal chain stops at each owner's proof boundary: Host checkpoint != current physical/domain truth; Harness candidate completion != Task/domain completion; Runtime Execution Result != External Effect Receipt != Semantic Completion. In particular arbitrary shell execution is OPAQUE: Runtime may prove exactly which local process ran while remaining unable to prove whether an email, payment, order or other external provider effect occurred. Such receipts/reconciliation and semantic judgments remain CALLER_OR_DOMAIN unless a narrow structured effect owner has an enforceable contract. Before adding any Ordivon owner, run the deletion test: if Git/SQLite/systemd/a Provider SDK/a scheduler/an isolation system already owns the complete requirement, choose CLASSICAL_SUBSTRATE; if no recurring unowned invariant and real shared-consumer pressure is demonstrated, choose NO_SHARED_MECHANISM. Causal explanation never authorizes a layer to cross its explicit negative boundary.

cases.scenario: A shell command called an email API and then lost its response. Local process termination is known exactly, but only the email provider can answer whether message id M was actually accepted and sent.

A bounded model episode loses its Provider response after possible dispatch. The caller's long-lived objective is unchanged; exact Provider-call identity and safe redispatch state must survive for the next model turn.
Two replacement AI sessions both resume the same week-long investigation and try to commit different semantic frontiers against the same current revision. Only one revision transition may win.
After daemon restart, operators must determine whether the exact admitted child process tree still exists, whether cancellation completed, and which digest-bound result bytes belong to that attempt.
The complete requirement is source version history, branch ancestry, exact commit identity, diff and rollback. No Agent execution or semantic continuity is involved.

A team wants a universal semantic-memory ranker that automatically chooses relevant old facts for every Agent, but there is no stable cross-domain relevance law or second workload proving a shared responsibility.

A local program submitted a market order. The process exit and stdout are perfectly retained, but authoritative proof of whether exchange order id O exists must come from the exchange's order/receipt state.
A bounded Agent episode produced a candidate-completed research answer with a full Run receipt. The domain's independent evaluator still has to decide whether the scientific claim is valid.
A physical test executable exits successfully, but the experiment's oracle says the hypothesis was falsified. The remaining question is whether the research objective is semantically satisfied.

Before changing a shared production resource, the responsible participant must durably accept the proposed consequence and that commitment must remain attached to the long-lived work after cognition replacement.

One Agent Run must remember which exact caller observations it selected as current cognition, which Tool exchanges occurred in this attempt, and where a pause/resume boundary sits. The parent Task need not change.
A newly admitted local operation binds exact source and executable/provider bytes. They change before dispatch, so the operation must refuse to spawn rather than silently execute different bytes.
A company only needs a generic distributed batch queue with priorities, worker placement and retry for deterministic jobs. There is no missing Agent-specific semantic invariant.
The requirement is a hostile multi-tenant sandbox with strong kernel isolation and controlled network egress against malicious same-host code, not owner-trusted local execution.

Someone proposes one generic EffectAdapter that lets callers label arbitrary shell commands READ_ONLY or IDEMPOTENT even though infrastructure cannot enforce the command's external behavior or reconciliation contract.
An application needs one stateless Provider SDK request with no Tools, no durable selected cognition, no pause/resume and no recovery after ambiguous dispatch beyond reporting the request failure.

Inside a bounded Agent episode, exact source objects already exist. The Agent must choose which source pins remain selected as current durable cognition; infrastructure must not rank or summarize them on its behalf.
A semantic work checkpoint remembers a Job id as a navigation hint. Hours later, the only question is whether that exact local Job is physically running, terminal, lost, or reconciled now.

No process is running and no model call is active, but an unfinished investigation's objective, unresolved unknowns, rejected routes and next actions must still be recoverable tomorrow by a different Agent.

A Game project has an evaluator rule whose meaning is specific to its own gameplay objective and evidence. It is already needed there, but no materially different project shares that semantic rule. Where should that evaluator meaning remain owned?

metrics.criticalExternalEffect: H01,H07: choosing an opaque Ordivon infrastructure owner is a critical proof-boundary overreach

classification.SUPERIOR: causal_boundary accuracy >= repository_first + 0.05, zero causal critical external-effect overreach, and causal anti-overbuild false-Ordivon <= repository
classification.SAFE_NONINFERIOR: causal_boundary accuracy >= 0.975, causal accuracy >= repository_first - 0.01, zero causal critical external-effect overreach, and causal anti-overbuild false-Ordivon <= repository

antiLeakage: all held-out cases and thresholds frozen before any held-out call
no E12 or E16 scenario is reused
opaque infrastructure labels are permuted per replicate and shared by paired treatments
same factual boundaries are present in both treatments; only explanatory organization differs
same cases/output schema and paired credential slot
no semantic answer repair or prior-output replay
